genetic.translationZh: 地球上所有150万种已知动植物的遗传密码将被绘制出来，以帮助拯救物种免于灭绝并促进人类健康。
genetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

genetic.sentenceEn: Dr. Tim Littlewood, head of Life Sciences Department at the Natural History Museum, said, "Whether you are interested in food or disease, the history of how every organism on the planet has adapted to its environment is recorded in its genetic makeup.
genetic.translationZh: 英国自然历史博物馆生命科学部主任蒂姆·利特尔伍德博士说：“无论你对食物还是疾病感兴趣，地球上每种生物如何适应环境的历史都记录在其基因构成中。”
genetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

genetic.sentenceEn: Scientists hope that cracking the genetic code of plants and animals could help uncover new treatments for infectious diseases, slow aging, improve crops in agriculture, and create new bio-materials.
genetic.translationZh: 科学家们希望，破解动植物的遗传密码能够帮助发现传染病的新疗法、延缓衰老、改良农业作物并创造新的生物材料。
genetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

genetic.sentenceEn: What do scientists hope to do by cracking the genetic code of plants and animals?
genetic.translationZh: 科学家希望通过破解动植物的遗传密码来做什么？

genetic.sentenceEn: It depends on one's genetic code.
genetic.translationZh: 这取决于一个人的遗传密码。

giant.sentenceEn: But less than an hour away in the Malaysian countryside, inside three giant , silver domes, scientists are trying to change the future of food.
giant.translationZh: 但在不到一小时车程的马来西亚乡村，三个巨大的银色圆顶建筑内，科学家们正试图改变食品的未来。

giant.sentenceEn: One hundred thirty-five students, four teachers, one giant classroom: This is what 9th grade looks like at Westwood High School, in Mesa, Arizona's largest school system.
giant.translationZh: 一百三十五名学生，四位老师，一间超大教室：这就是亚利桑那州最大学区梅萨市韦斯特伍德高中九年级的上课场景。
giant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

giant.sentenceEn: In his new book, Hooked, Moss updates the food giants ' efforts to keep us eating what they serve, and how they're responding to complaints from consumers and health advocates.
giant.translationZh: 在他的新书《上钩》中，莫斯详细阐述了食品巨头如何想方设法让我们持续食用他们的产品，以及他们如何回应消费者和健康倡导者的投诉。
giant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

giant.sentenceEn: When Diageo, a British drinks giant , built a brewery in western Kenya, it wanted to use local crops to make a beer cheap enough to compete with illicit home brew.
giant.translationZh: 当英国饮料巨头帝亚吉欧公司在肯尼亚西部建立 brewery 时，它希望使用当地农作物酿造价格足够低廉的啤酒，以与非法家庭自酿酒竞争。

giant.sentenceEn: What have EU countries done to confront the power of digital giants ?
giant.translationZh: 欧盟国家做了什么来对抗数字巨头的力量？

giant.sentenceEn: They have imposed strict regulation over digital giants ' advertising.
giant.translationZh: 他们对数字巨头的广告业务实施了严格监管。

gather.sentenceEn: More than just books and banks of computers, libraries are still places where individuals gather to explore, interact, and imagine.
gather.translationZh: 图书馆不仅仅是书籍和一排排电脑的存放地，它依然是人们聚集在一起探索、交流和畅想的场所。

gather.sentenceEn: It's a French phrase that means to gather and arrange the ingredients and tools needed for cooking.
gather.translationZh: 这是一个法语短语，意思是收集并整理烹饪所需的食材和工具。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

gather.sentenceEn: They found that if pollution is frozen to around –18 ℃ in a condensing tube, the particles gather together and fall to the bottom, allowing fresh, clean air to pass through.
gather.translationZh: 研究发现，如果在冷凝管中将污染物冷冻到约 -18 ℃，颗粒就会聚集成团并沉降到底部，从而让清新洁净的空气通过。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

gather.sentenceEn: Several dozen humans are gathered together in a dark, undecorated room.
gather.translationZh: 几十个成年人聚集在一间昏暗、未经装饰的房间里。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

gather.sentenceEn: In future, if social scientists are serious about testing theories of morality, they will need to gather new data, more systematically, out in the field.
gather.translationZh: 将来，如果社会科学家真想检验道德理论，他们就需要在现实环境中更系统地收集新数据。
gather.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第9句

gather.sentenceEn: Help gather information publicly available to researchers.
gather.translationZh: 帮助收集研究人员可公开获取的信息。

gender.sentenceEn: Had that trend continued, the gender wage gap would have been closed by 2017.
gender.translationZh: 如果这一趋势持续下去，性别工资差距本可以在2017年消除。
gender.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

gender.sentenceEn: The gender pay gap is one of the most outstanding examples of that lack of parity(平等), and still exists just about everywhere.
gender.translationZh: 性别薪酬差距是这种不平等最突出的例子之一，而且几乎在所有地方依然存在。
gender.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

gender.sentenceEn: During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.
gender.translationZh: 在那十年间，性别薪酬差距每年缩小约1个百分点。
gender.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

gender.sentenceEn: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.
gender.translationZh: 事实上，美国推出家庭休假政策后，性别工资差距的缩小速度降至每年仅0.03个百分点，此后一直维持在这一水平。
gender.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

gender.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the gender pay gap in the US during the 1980s?
gender.translationZh: 关于20世纪80年代美国的性别薪酬差距，我们了解到了什么？

gender.sentenceEn: The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention.
gender.translationZh: 性别薪酬差距的缩小引起了更多关注。

gratitude.sentenceEn: We rarely contemplate the globalized avenues of free trade with gratitude .
gratitude.translationZh: 我们很少怀着感激之情思考全球化的自由贸易渠道。

gratitude.sentenceEn: Gratitude for the anonymous men and women who make up the supply chain rarely makes its way into our consciousness.
gratitude.translationZh: 我们很少会想到要感谢那些构成供应链的无名男女。

gratitude.sentenceEn: It's exceedingly difficult for human beings to feel gratitude toward strangers, and the global marketplace that has made us so rich has also made us strangers to one another.
gratitude.translationZh: 人类很难对陌生人怀有感激之情，而让我们变得如此富有的全球市场，也让我们彼此成为了陌生人。

gratitude.sentenceEn: Impressing a sense of dependence upon and gratitude toward foreign strangers is therefore an uphill task.
gratitude.translationZh: 因此，要让人们对外来陌生人产生依赖感和感激之情，是一项艰巨的任务。

gratitude.sentenceEn: Gratitude is one of the healthiest and most nourishing of all states of mind, and those who adopt it as a habit are enriching not only their own lives but also the lives of those around them.
gratitude.translationZh: 感恩是所有心境中最健康、最滋养人的一种，将感恩培养成习惯的人不仅在丰富自己的生活，也在丰富身边人的生活。

gratitude.sentenceEn: Gratitude is likely to enhance one's sense of being connected with other people.
gratitude.translationZh: 感恩有助于增强一个人与他人的联结感。

greatly.sentenceEn: As a result, the FAO's comparison of greenhouse gas emissions from livestock to those from transportation was greatly distorted.
greatly.translationZh: 因此，粮农组织将 livestock 温室气体排放与交通运输排放进行的比较存在严重失真。

greatly.sentenceEn: The standard for English in British newsreels(新闻片) from the 1950s, for example, differs greatly from the standard found on American national news broadcasts today.
greatly.translationZh: 例如，20 世纪 50 年代英国新闻片中的英语标准与当今美国国家新闻广播中的英语标准存在巨大差异。
greatly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

greatly.sentenceEn: Yet on the ground, the Bay area has changed greatly since singer Tony Bennett left his heart here.
greatly.translationZh: 然而在现实中，自从歌手托尼·贝内特将心留在这里以来，湾区已经发生了巨大的变化。

greatly.sentenceEn: When a lucky few have access to the knowledge, they will benefit greatly .
greatly.translationZh: 当少数幸运儿掌握了这些信息，他们将受益匪浅。
greatly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

greatly.sentenceEn: Merian contributed greatly to people's better understanding of medicine and science.
greatly.translationZh: 梅里安为人们更好地理解医学和科学做出了巨大贡献。

greatly.sentenceEn: It benefits us greatly one way or another.
greatly.translationZh: 无论如何，这都让我们获益匪浅。

graduation.sentenceEn: I was in the limelight when I was still a high school student and went professional right after high school graduation , which was a mistake.
graduation.translationZh: 我高中时就已备受瞩目，毕业后直接进入职业联赛，这其实是个错误。
graduation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

graduation.sentenceEn: Ministers, according to Onward, should "crack down on courses that offer extremely limited value for money to students ten years after graduation ", restricting the ability of such courses to recruit new students, if the average graduate earns below the student loans payment threshold.
graduation.translationZh: 前进智库认为，部长们应该“严厉打击那些在毕业生离校十年后仍无法为其带来足够经济回报的课程”，如果某课程毕业生的平均收入低于学生贷款还款门槛，就应限制该类课程的招生名额。
graduation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

graduation.sentenceEn: According to their data, the majority of creative arts students earn less than 25,000 pounds a year, ten years after graduation .
graduation.translationZh: 根据他们的数据，大多数创意艺术专业学生在毕业十年后年收入低于25,000英镑。
graduation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

graduation.sentenceEn: Well, 40 percent of all graduates—regardless of their degree—are on less than 25,000 pounds a year, 5 years after graduation .
graduation.translationZh: 然而，所有毕业生中——无论其专业为何——有40%在毕业5年后的年薪低于25,000英镑。
graduation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

graduation.sentenceEn: What do we learn about British college graduates five years after graduation ?
graduation.translationZh: 关于英国大学毕业生毕业后五年的情况，我们了解到什么？

graduation.sentenceEn: Seek financially viable employment opportunities after graduation .
graduation.translationZh: 毕业后寻求经济上可行的就业机会。

gradually.sentenceEn: Over the past 20 years, the internet has gradually become a dominant feature of our lives.
gradually.translationZh: 在过去的20年里，互联网已逐渐成为我们生活中的一个主导性特征。
gradually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

gradually.sentenceEn: We've reached this point so gradually that many of us have never questioned it.
gradually.translationZh: 我们已在不知不觉中走到了这一步，以至于许多人从未对此提出过质疑。
gradually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

gradually.sentenceEn: You will take those days off, and I expect that you will gradually come back to your usual self.
gradually.translationZh: 你就休这几天假，我希望你能慢慢恢复到往常的状态。
gradually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第3句

gradually.sentenceEn: "As the number of children who have biophobia increases, public interest and support for biodiversity conservation will gradually decline. Although many conservation biologists still consider that preventing the loss of wildlife habitat is the most important way to conserve biodiversity, I think preventing increased biophobia is also important for conservation."
gradually.translationZh: 随着患有生物恐惧症的儿童数量增加，公众对生物多样性保护的兴趣和支持将逐渐下降。尽管许多保护生物学家仍然认为，防止野生动物栖息地的丧失是保护生物多样性最重要的方式，但我认为防止生物恐惧症加剧对保护工作也同样重要。

gradually.sentenceEn: When you're at Position 7, your time is better spent connecting with people who are at Positions 6 and 8, gradually pulling them in your direction.
gradually.translationZh: 如果你处于第7位，那么你最好将时间花在与第6位和第8位的人建立联系上，逐步将他们拉向你的方向。

gradually.sentenceEn: It is destined to change gradually .

grand.sentenceEn: For most passersby humming through the Mojave on their way to try their luck in Las Vegas or heading towards the Grand Canyon, it's just a flat stretch of land with some mountains in the distance and more apt to be a setting for a movie that takes place on Mars.
grand.translationZh: 对于大多数驾车匆匆穿过莫哈韦沙漠的路人——他们要么是去拉斯维加斯碰运气，要么是前往大峡谷——这片沙漠不过是一片平坦的土地，远处有些山脉，更像是火星题材电影的取景地。
grand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

grand.sentenceEn: This kind of clash inevitably takes place on a grand scale.
grand.translationZh: 这类冲突不可避免地会大规模爆发。

grand.sentenceEn: However, after a lifetime of moving within the circles of power, he was unable to break with authority, and served Mussolini faithfully (as president of Italy's national research council and royal academy, as well as a member of the Fascist Grand Council) until the day he died—conveniently—in 1937, shortly before he would have had to take a stand in the conflict that consumed a world that he had, in part, created.
grand.translationZh: 然而，在权力圈子中周旋了一生之后，他已无法与权威决裂，而是一直忠实地为墨索里尼效力（担任意大利国家研究委员会主席、皇家科学院院长以及法西斯大委员会成员），直至1937年他"适时"离世——就在他即将不得不对那场吞噬了一个部分由他亲手创造的世界的冲突表明立场之前不久。

grand.sentenceEn: This is a grand challenge for our age and it may require an "irrational" response.
grand.translationZh: 这是我们这个时代面临的重大挑战，而应对它可能需要一种“非理性”的反应。
grand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

grand.sentenceEn: With more than $12 billion in sales this year, the industry is booming and, according to the market research company, Grand View Research, is on track to sell billions more by 2025.
grand.translationZh: 该行业今年的销售额已超过120亿美元，呈现蓬勃发展态势。市场研究公司Grand View Research的数据显示，到2025年，该行业的销售额有望再增加数十亿美元。

grand.sentenceEn: How did the Grand Tour influence the architecture in England?
grand.translationZh: 大游学如何影响了英国的建筑？

grocery.sentenceEn: Americans' growing aversion to spending time in the kitchen signifies a host of challenges for the grocery industry.
grocery.translationZh: 美国人日益厌恶在厨房劳作，这给杂货零售业带来了一系列挑战。
grocery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第17句

grocery.sentenceEn: But today the bambara murukku is one of CFF's best reviewed foods and they are aiming to get it into grocery stores, pointing to the success of crops like quinoa to potential investors.
grocery.translationZh: 但如今，班巴拉穆鲁库已成为CFF评价最高的食品之一，他们正计划将其推入杂货店市场，并以藜麦等作物的成功案例向潜在投资者展示前景。

grocery.sentenceEn: For Moss, this puts the notion of "fast food" in an entirely new light as this isn't limited to fast food chains-almost 90% of food products in grocery stores are processed foods.
grocery.translationZh: 在莫斯看来，这为“快餐”概念赋予了全新的含义——这一概念并不局限于快餐连锁店，因为杂货店中近90%的食品都是加工食品。
grocery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第8句

grocery.sentenceEn: While creating labels that play on consumer fears and misconceptions about their food may give a company a temporary marketing advantage over competing products on the grocery aisle, in the long term this strategy will have just the opposite effect: by injecting fear into the discourse about our food, we run the risk of eroding consumer trust in not just a single product, but the entire food business.
grocery.translationZh: 虽然设计利用消费者对食品的恐惧和误解的标签可能会让公司在杂货店货架上获得相对于竞争产品的暂时营销优势，但从长远来看，这种策略将产生恰恰相反的效果：通过在关于我们食品的讨论中注入恐惧，我们不仅可能削弱消费者对单一产品的信任，还可能动摇他们对整个食品行业的信任。
grocery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

grocery.sentenceEn: What does the passage say signifies a host of challenges for America's grocery industry?
grocery.translationZh: 文中提到的哪些迹象表明美国食品零售业正面临诸多挑战？

grocery.sentenceEn: He had got some groceries at a big discount.
grocery.translationZh: 他以很大的折扣买了些杂货。

given.sentenceEn: It's hard to make a compelling argument that the United States has a calorie deficit, given its high national rates of adult and child obesity.
given.translationZh: 鉴于美国成人和儿童肥胖率居高不下，很难让人相信美国存在热量摄入不足的问题。

given.sentenceEn: It is hard to say if Mother's Day spending is rising more than one would expect, given that the American population keeps growing, but one factor might be that the proportion of women who are the mothers of adult children is rising.
given.translationZh: 考虑到美国人口持续增长，母亲节的消费增长是否超出预期，这一点很难说，但一个可能的因素是，身为成年子女母亲的女性比例正在上升。
given.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

given.sentenceEn: This means that, at any given time, a larger share of women, and thus of the whole population, will report not having children in government surveys.
given.translationZh: 这意味着，在任何特定时间点，在政府调查中报告没有子女的女性比例会更高，因此在整个人口中的比例也会更高。
given.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

given.sentenceEn: Many cultures have traditional names for the full moon in a given month or season, so there's quite a list to draw from if you're trying to really juice up a story on a slightly-bigger-than-average view of the moon.
given.translationZh: 许多文化都为特定月份或季节的满月赋予了传统名称，因此，如果你想为一篇描写比平常更大一些的月亮的故事增添几分色彩，这里有不少素材可供选择。

given.sentenceEn: A full moon in a given month or season gets a specific name in different cultures.
given.translationZh: 在不同文化中，特定月份或季节出现的满月都有其专属名称。

given.sentenceEn: It is unlikely to survive given the on-going changes.
given.translationZh: 考虑到正在发生的变化，它不太可能存活下来。

globe.sentenceEn: While women are underrepresented in governments around the globe , it is a particularly formidable problem in the United States.
globe.translationZh: 尽管全球各国政府中女性代表人数不足，但这一问题在美国尤为严峻。
globe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

globe.sentenceEn: It is obviously good news if prosperity is more shared across the globe .
globe.translationZh: 如果全球能更广泛地共享繁荣，这显然是个好消息。
globe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

globe.sentenceEn: There is scarcely a single commodity in any American household that isn't dependent for its manufacture and sale, through one supply chain or another, on scores of different people spread out across the entire globe .
globe.translationZh: 美国家庭中的任何一种商品，其生产和销售几乎都要通过这样或那样的供应链，依赖遍布全球的众多不同人员。

globe.sentenceEn: It could be that our raw intelligence gave us an unprecedented ability to think outside the box, innovating solutions to thorny problems as people migrated across the globe .
globe.translationZh: 这可能是因为我们原始的智力赋予了我们前所未有的跳出思维定势的能力，在人类向全球迁移的过程中不断创新，解决棘手难题。
globe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

globe.sentenceEn: Fewer than 300,000 wild chimpanzees live in a few forested corners of Africa today, while humans have colonized every corner of the globe .
globe.translationZh: 如今，仅存不到30万只野生黑猩猩生活在非洲几片森林地带，而人类却已定居全球各个角落。
globe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

globe.sentenceEn: In today's hyper connected times, our addiction to bad news just leads us to vacuum up depressing or enraging stories from across the globe .
globe.translationZh: 在当今这个高度互联的时代，我们对坏消息的沉迷只会让我们疯狂吸纳来自全球各地的令人沮丧或愤怒的故事。
globe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

guarantee.sentenceEn: Although it can generate foreign exchange, income and employment, there's no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably among local communities.
guarantee.translationZh: 尽管旅游业能够创造外汇收入、提供就业机会，但无法保证跨国酒店连锁企业会在当地社区间公平分配这些利益。

guarantee.sentenceEn: Central control and collective organisation can produce smoother and fairer outcomes, though even that much is never guaranteed .

genuine.sentenceEn: Although humans are more advanced and intelligent, animals are more genuine and authentic in their behavior and responses than human beings.
genuine.translationZh: 尽管人类更为先进和聪慧，但动物在行为和反应上比人类更加真诚和真实。
genuine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

genuine.sentenceEn: When we hide our emotions and our true feelings, we stop being genuine , spontaneous and authentic in our relationships.
genuine.translationZh: 当我们隐藏自己的情绪和真实感受时，在人际关系中我们就不再真诚、自然和真实。
genuine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

genuine.sentenceEn: Imitated Burberry products discouraged luxury consumers from buying its genuine products.
genuine.translationZh: 仿冒博柏利产品阻碍了奢侈品消费者购买其正品。
它代表了真正的美国艺术。

gram.sentenceEn: That meant they were eating 90 grams of protein a day.
gram.translationZh: 这意味着他们每天摄入90克蛋白质。

gram.sentenceEn: Add a lunch of chicken, rice and broccoli(西兰花), and you are already over the recommended 50 grams .
gram.translationZh: 再加上一顿包含鸡肉、米饭和西兰花的午餐，你摄入的蛋白质就已经超过了建议的50克。

gram.sentenceEn: The other group—the control group—was put on a typical low-calorie diet with about 50 to 60 grams of protein a day.
gram.translationZh: 另一组——对照组——则采用典型的低热量饮食，每天摄入约50至60克蛋白质。

gram.sentenceEn: If you ate two eggs topped with a little bit of cheese and an orange on the side, you already have 22 grams of protein.
gram.translationZh: 如果你吃两个鸡蛋，上面加一点奶酪，再配上一个橙子，你就已经摄入了22克蛋白质。

gram.sentenceEn: Each egg gives you 7 grams , the cheese gives you around 6 grams and the orange—about 2 grams .
gram.translationZh: 每个鸡蛋能提供7克蛋白质，奶酪约6克，橙子则约2克。

gram.sentenceEn: Participants in the study were separated into two groups—one group was asked to eat 30 grams of protein per meal in the form of whole foods.
gram.translationZh: 该研究的参与者被分为两组——其中一组被要求每餐摄入30克天然食物形式的蛋白质。

generous.sentenceEn: And those adult children may spend more generously when it comes to celebrating the moms they no longer live with.
generous.translationZh: 而这些成年子女在庆祝与自己分开居住的母亲时，可能会花费得更加慷慨。
generous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

generous.sentenceEn: In saying this, Wooden sought to promote purely generous acts, as opposed to those performed with an expectation of reward.
generous.translationZh: 通过这句话，伍登旨在倡导纯粹的慷慨行为，而非那些期望获得回报的行为。

generous.sentenceEn: One is the fact that expressing gratitude encourages others to continue being generous , thus promoting a virtuous cycle of goodness in relationships.
generous.translationZh: 其一，表达感激之情能鼓励他人继续保持慷慨，从而在人际关系中促成一个良性的善行循环。

generous.sentenceEn: A bear, prompted by the food that a lady kept offering to him, entered the car where the generous person was sitting.
generous.translationZh: 一位女士不断向一只熊投喂食物，在食物的引诱下，这只熊钻进了她乘坐的汽车。
generous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

generous.sentenceEn: I'm talking about those who consistently believe they deserve special treatment and generous rewards.
generous.translationZh: 我说的是那些一直认为自己理应享受特殊待遇和丰厚奖励的人。
generous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

generous.sentenceEn: A basketball coach advocated performing generous acts without expecting anything in return.
generous.translationZh: 一位篮球教练主张进行慷慨的行为，不期望任何回报。

genetically.sentenceEn: Yet the paper does say children are "unintentionally genetically selected" by the school system.
genetically.translationZh: 然而，该论文确实指出，学校系统在“无意中对儿童进行了基因选择”。
genetically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

genetically.sentenceEn: While there's an undoubted genetic basis to individual difference, it is wrong to think that socially defined groups can be genetically accounted for.
genetically.translationZh: 虽然个体差异无疑有其遗传基础，但认为社会定义的群体可以用遗传来解释却是错误的。
genetically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

genetically.sentenceEn: Actually, behavioral geneticists believe that less than half of the total weight variation is programmed in the genes, while height is almost entirely genetically determined.
genetically.translationZh: 实际上，行为遗传学家认为，体重差异中仅有不到一半是由基因决定的，而身高则几乎完全由基因决定。
genetically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

genetically.sentenceEn: "Instead of focusing only on the conservation of genetically based entities like species, we now need to also consider culturally based entities," says Andrew Whiten.
genetically.translationZh: 安德鲁·怀滕说：“我们不应只专注于保护物种等基于基因的实体，现在还需要考虑基于文化的实体。”
genetically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

genetically.sentenceEn: She says she is aware that plenty of people do not want to eat genetically modified crops, but she is pushing ahead with every available tool until one works.
genetically.translationZh: 她说她知道很多人不愿意食用转基因作物，但她仍在尝试所有可用的方法，直到找到一种可行的方案。

genetically.sentenceEn: They are genetically determined to need less sleep.
genetically.translationZh: 他们的基因决定了他们需要更少的睡眠。

glance.sentenceEn: Think about how difficult it must have been not to glance at your phone when it was within reach, or not to walk to the vending machine when your afternoon slump hit.
glance.translationZh: 想想看，当手机就在手边却不能看一眼，或是当午后困倦袭来却不能走向自动售货机，这该有多难。

glance.sentenceEn: Their heart rate is elevated, they occasionally glance around nervously, and they sometimes jump collectively in their seats, and emit high-pitched warning calls.
glance.translationZh: 他们的心率加快，偶尔紧张地环顾四周，有时会集体从座位上跳起，并发出尖锐的警告声。
glance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

glance.sentenceEn: At first glance , it might even seem like Onward have a point.
glance.translationZh: 乍一看，Onward智库的观点似乎不无道理。
glance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

glance.sentenceEn: At first glance it looks lifeless, barren, and bone-dry.
glance.translationZh: 乍一看，这里了无生机，一片荒芜，干燥得如同枯骨。
glance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

glance.sentenceEn: Virtually every American can recognize a dollar bill at a mere glance .
glance.translationZh: 几乎每个美国人都能一眼认出一美元纸币。
glance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

glance.sentenceEn: Seeing others enjoy a smoke, or sneak a quick glance , is too tempting to resist and soon everyone is doing it.
glance.translationZh: 看到别人享受吸烟，或偷偷瞥一眼手机，这种诱惑让人难以抗拒，很快所有人都会跟着做。

globalization.sentenceEn: If we really care about global welfare, globalization is the only way forward to ensure that economic prosperity is shared among all countries and not only a select few advanced economies.
globalization.translationZh: 如果我们真正关心全球福祉，全球化是确保经济繁荣惠及所有国家，而非仅由少数发达经济体独享的唯一途径。
globalization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

globalization.sentenceEn: While inequality within countries has gone up as a result of globalization , global inequality has been on a steady downward trend for several decades.
globalization.translationZh: 尽管全球化导致国家内部的不平等加剧，但几十年来全球不平等一直呈稳步下降趋势。
globalization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

globalization.sentenceEn: While it is true that globalization has put some downward pressure on middle-class wages in advanced economies in recent decades, it has also helped lift hundreds of millions of people above the global poverty line.
globalization.translationZh: 诚然，近几十年来全球化给发达经济体的中产阶级工资带来了一定下行压力，但它也帮助数亿人摆脱了全球贫困线。
globalization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

globalization.sentenceEn: I taught a seminar on globalization and I assigned a reading that I had written about global capital flows.
globalization.translationZh: 我教授了一门关于全球化的研讨课，并布置了一篇我撰写的有关全球资本流动的阅读材料。
globalization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

globalization.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say about globalization ?
globalization.translationZh: 演讲者对全球化有何看法？

globalization.sentenceEn: The globalization process will be accelerated.
